title: Do LLM Self-Explanations Help Users Predict Model Behavior? Evaluating Counterfactual Simulatability with Pragmatic Perturbations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the frequency with which an evaluator (human or LLM judge) simply reuses a model's original answer to a starter question when asked to predict the model's answer to a counterfactual follow-up question, particularly evaluating if self-explanations mitigate this tendency when the initial answer is incorrect.
